name: images_crop
description: Crop to `aspectRatio`: center by default, or `auto=true` for AI focal-point crop that keeps the subject. Pixels: `images_resize`. AI upscale: `images_upscale`. Ratios: 1:1, 16:9, 9:16, 4:3, 3:4, 3:2, 2:3, 21:9.

auto.description: true = AI focal-point crop that keeps the subject. Default false = center-crop. Both cost 1 credit.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.

prompt.description: Subject hint for auto crop, e.g. "the dog". Ignored unless auto.
